subject: Project updates
text: The updated timeline now includes a clearer phase for data review, and the shared folder has a revised task list. Several classmates have started the first drafts, though the survey responses are still slower than expected. We have shortened the interview guide based on your suggestion that participants may not recall recent changes accurately. This change seems to have improved early responses, and we will keep it unless you see another concern. For the next check-in, we can send a brief summary of obstacles and the exact date when the cleaned dataset should be ready. If you prefer a written list instead of a short meeting, we will use that format. Thank you for keeping the scope realistic while still pressing us to define the measurement more carefully.
